design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (debit_card_disputes_and_card_servicing)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. One prerequisite problem; the dispute-amount computation takes 4 factors, the on-filing credit 6. Occupied by task 0: card_ext_takeover_card_liability, card_ext_takeover_card_final_credit, tools file_unauthorized_card_dispute_b9450be9 and post_takeover_dispute_credit_edfadedb (unauthorized disputes, takeover lock, liability, approval on filing). Claimed here, disjoint: card_ext_single_use_incorrect_amount (file_incorrect_amount_card_dispute_a0bf950b, owner=user) and card_ext_single_use_filing_credit (post_on_filing_dispute_credit_86bd6080, owner=agent) — a merchant dispute (the customer made the purchase), no liability, a partial credit on filing that replaces the small-dispute auto-credit. Last task: no headroom to reserve; the two tasks together cover all four extended policies.
Design thesis: surface goal "the caterer charged my single-use card way more than the order; I want the extra back" -> the on-filing credit states it is not booked until the purchase stands under an open incorrect-amount dispute -> that dispute is the customer's own filing, whose disputed amount is a 4-factor computation over the card's authorizations, purchase and credits -> the credit (6 factors) is measured against the recorded overcharge. Depth: 2 problems, one value_input edge. Breadth: the card's authorizations, purchase, foreign flag, settlement lag and merchant credits; the linked personal account's opening date, plan, limitation history and three-month direct deposits (cross-difficulty wallet).
Why single-object: a single-use virtual card carries one purchase by design, so card-level aggregates are exactly that purchase's authorizations, settlement and credits.

[Problem-tree card] root = card_ext_single_use_filing_credit; prerequisite = card_ext_single_use_incorrect_amount. Edge: value_input, gate overcharge_on_record, form state. Prerequisite sentence (negated direction, the way a disputes desk says a credit is not given until a claim stands): "The credit on filing is not booked until the single-use card's purchase stands on the records with an open incorrect-amount dispute." Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; waits on a record-visible state (an open incorrect-amount dispute record on the card); no tool, id or code token; hard requirement, scoped to the single-use card's purchase. Only one write of the difficulty creates a card_dispute_filed record of reason incorrect_amount: file_incorrect_amount_card_dispute_a0bf950b (the other filing writes reason unauthorized). Derivation: sentence + find_card_disputes (no dispute on the card ending 2785) + the incorrect-amount policy's rule ("the amount the cardholder disputes as an incorrect amount on the purchase made with a single-use virtual card") -> the customer's own filing. False at the opening: the only dispute records are the physical card's 2025 incorrect-amount dispute (card_txn_id = the cinema purchase o1) and its denial. Order: filing (step 8) -> credit (step 10). Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 8 recomputes the credit to 0.0 instead of 47.75. The charter now carries both directions of prerequisite sentence (task 0 "only after", task 1 "not ... until").

[Base-invariant card] Filing (card_dispute_filed): card_disputes_unauthorized gates card_blocked_first (its condition restricts unauthorized disputes; this is a merchant dispute, so it is met vacuously — the single-use card is active), unauthorized_window (60 days from 2026-09-08, day 16), one_dispute_per_transaction (no dispute on the purchase); card_disputes_merchant gates merchant_window (120 days, day 16, last day 2027-01-06 inclusive) and merchant_contacted_first (retired by the declared overwrite: incorrect amounts need no merchant contact — the base clause itself says so; the gate's caller-statement binding to a transaction id could not be satisfied verbatim, a blueprint defect routed around here). Credit (card_dispute_credit): no structured gate; the base small-dispute auto-credit sentences of both dispute policies are superseded (declared) by the on-filing ceiling.

[Business-object card] Target: the 172.75 purchase PWC 6630 9014 at Maple & Rye Catering Windsor on the single-use card ending 2785, settled 2026-09-08 against authorization AUTH 3M8R2D (80.00). Included: the three same-day authorizations (80.00, 12.00 AUTH 3M8R2E, 8.00 AUTH 3M8R2F), both unlinked merchant credits (4.00 CR 7719 0041, 2.00 CR 7719 0057). Excluded: the releases of the incremental authorizations (not new authorizations), the 1.73 foreign fee (a fee, not the purchase), the physical card's cinema purchase and its denied dispute. Both writes carry card_txn_id = the purchase; the credit links source_txn_id to it.

[Factor card — dispute amount, 4 factors] (1) authorized_reference_rule, method, multi-source: {2+ authorizations all on one day -> total of all} / {2+ on different days -> largest single} / {one -> the one settled against}. World: three on 2026-09-05 -> 100.00; baseline 80.00 gives 72.75. Near-miss: the purchase points only to the 80.00 authorization — reading "the authorization the purchase settled against" under-counts. (2) gratuity_rate_tier, parameter, multi-source: dining AND online -> 15; dining AND contactless -> 20; else 0. World dining online -> 15.00; baseline gives 64.25. (3) exchange_tolerance_tier, parameter, multi-source: foreign AND settled >= 3 days after the latest authorization -> 2.5; foreign AND < 3 -> 1.0; domestic -> 0. World 3 days -> 2.50; baseline gives 51.75. (4) merchant_credit_rule, method: {credits, none linked -> all} / {linked and unlinked -> linked + latest unlinked} / {else -> linked only}. World two unlinked -> 6.00; baseline 0.00 gives 55.25. Result 172.75 - 100.00 - 15.00 - 2.50 - 6.00 = 49.25; all baseline 92.75.
[Factor card — on-filing credit, 6 factors] (1) tenure_multiplier_tier, parameter (its tiers select the multiplier value that enters one fixed product), cross wallet: >= 60 months x1.5; >= 24 x1.25; else x1. World 39 months -> 31.25; baseline 40.00. (2) deposit_uplift_tier, parameter, cross wallet: three-month deposits >= 4000.00 -> 10.00; >= 300.00 -> 5.00; else 0. World 3720.00 -> 5.00 (near-miss: counting the 2026-06-01 deposit gives 4960.00 and the high tier); baseline 41.25. (3) plan_uplift_tier, parameter, cross wallet: Onyx/Summit 6.00; Plus/Prime 3.00; Lite/Core 0. World Prime -> 3.00; baseline 43.25. (4) standing_uplift_tier, parameter, cross wallet: never restricted 4.00; last limitation lifted >= 12 months before 2.00; else 0. World returned_funding lifted 2024-09-04 -> 2.00; baseline 46.75. (5) merchant_ack_tier, parameter: credits >= 5.00 -> 5.00; > 0 -> 2.00; none 0. World 6.00 -> 5.00; baseline 41.25. (6) near_ceiling_release, method: excess <= 2.00 -> whole overcharge; <= 5.00 -> ceiling + half the excess; else lower of the two. World excess 3.00 -> 47.75; baseline 46.25. Ceiling 46.25; result 47.75; all baseline 25.00 (the Signature threshold alone).

[Seed] Customer Renata Escobedo; personal account Pocketwire Prime opened 2023-06-19, last limitation returned_funding placed 2024-08-21T14:02:00 and lifted 2024-09-04, ledger_balance 4920.04 = 4 x 1240.00 deposits - 4 x 9.99 plan fees; physical Signature card ending 2049; single-use Signature card ending 2785 issued 2026-09-05. Automatic clauses checked: incremental holds released on day 7 (2026-09-12); foreign fee 1.73 = 1.00 percent of 172.75 half up; merchant credits unlinked so no proportional fee refund or points clawback fires; the 2025 dispute of 31.40 was above the 25.00 auto-credit threshold and denied for missing documents; no due obligation is left open.

[Persona] Organized, indignant scheduler who lays events out in order; volunteers the surface goal and the settled 172.75 and that the order came to about a hundred; gives phone, DOB, ZIP when asked (SSN/email only if needed); on request gives the card ending 2785, first contact with the caterer on September 10, refunds of 4 and 2; files in her own name when handed the step; accepts the credit figure and the note that the rest stays in dispute, then ends. No mention of disputes to be filed first, allowances or ceilings.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB, ZIP) -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> find_card_disputes -> find_wallet_accounts -> find_wallet_transactions -> unlock+call (user) file_incorrect_amount_card_dispute_a0bf950b(card 2785, purchase, 49.25) -> unlock+call post_on_filing_dispute_credit_86bd6080(47.75).
[Verification run] Authoring evaluator printed: dispute amount (49.25, {authorized_reference_rule: 72.75, gratuity_rate_tier: 64.25, exchange_tolerance_tier: 51.75, merchant_credit_rule: 55.25}, 92.75); credit (47.75, {tenure_multiplier_tier: 40.0, deposit_uplift_tier: 41.25, plan_uplift_tier: 43.25, standing_uplift_tier: 46.75, merchant_ack_tier: 41.25, near_ceiling_release: 46.25}, 25.0); credit with step 8 skipped 0.0. Gate outputs are recorded in the difficulty worklog.md.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules, tool schemas and finder returns alone: the credit must wait for a filed incorrect-amount dispute; the customer files it; amount 49.25; credit 47.75 — equal to gold. Easy mistakes: using the 80.00 settled-against authorization, skipping the gratuity or exchange allowance, ignoring unlinked credits, counting the June deposit, crediting the whole overcharge or only the ceiling, or crediting before the filing.
[Rework r2] F2 (policy audit): tenure_multiplier_tier relabelled effect: parameter (ladder tiers now carry value K('long_tenure_multiplier') / K('mid_tenure_multiplier') / 1); factor_trace[0] of the credit computation relabelled likewise. The credit computation now has 5 parameter factors and 1 method factor (near_ceiling_release); gold, baselines and sensitivities are unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Renata Escobedo, 33, a bus scheduler for the transit authority in Detroit. You are organized, a bit indignant, and you like to lay out what happened in order before you let the agent talk. For your niece's graduation party you ordered catering online from Maple & Rye Catering Windsor, a caterer across the border in Ontario, and you paid with a single-use virtual card from Pocketwire. The order came to about a hundred dollars with the add-ons, but on the 8th the charge settled at $172.75. The caterer later sent back a couple of small refunds and then stopped answering your emails. You open by saying roughly: "A caterer charged my single-use card way more than the order came to, $172.75, and I want the extra back." You do not know Pocketwire's rules and you do not propose any procedure or figure. When the agent asks who you are you give your mobile number 5552623190, and when asked for more your date of birth, 1993-02-26, and your home ZIP code, 48207; only if the agent still needs another detail do you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2374, or your email, renata.escobedo@pw2mail.example. If the agent asks, you say the single-use card is the one ending 2785, you first emailed the caterer on September 10, and the two refunds you saw were $4 and $2; you have no receipt showing a different total beyond the order confirmation, which you cannot pull up right now. If the agent explains that the dispute has to be put in by you, in your own name, you agree, and when the agent hands the step to you, you do it exactly as laid out and read back the confirmation that comes up. When the agent tells you how much is being credited back to the card now and that anything not credited stays in dispute, you accept it without arguing about the figure, say thank you, and end the call.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller wants the extra back now; for an open incorrect-amount dispute of a single-use card purchase the charter credits on filing up to the on-filing ceiling, so this credit (not an approval outcome, not a provisional credit) is selected.

base_preconditions.condition: Dispute credits: no structured gate of the unauthorized-dispute rules applies to a dispute credit; the on-filing credit replaces the small-dispute auto-credit for this scope.
Merchant-dispute credits: the dispute credited is the incorrect-amount dispute filed at step 8; no structured gate applies to the credit.

temporal_feasibility.condition: the dispute is filed no later than unauthorized_report_days calendar days after the disputed card transaction's date

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The report window is counted in calendar days from the disputed card transaction's date, the day after the transaction being day 1, and a dispute filed on the last day is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: Transaction date 2026-09-08, Signature unauthorized_report_days 60: last day 2026-11-07; 2026-11-08 would be refused (the gate restricts unauthorized disputes only).
boundary_check.at_boundary: 2026-09-24 is day 16 of 60; 2026-11-07 would still be accepted (inclusive).

temporal_feasibility.condition: the dispute is filed no later than merchant_dispute_days calendar days after the card transaction date

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The merchant window is counted in calendar days from the card transaction date, the day after the transaction being day 1, and a dispute filed on the last day is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: Transaction date 2026-09-08, merchant_dispute_days 120: last day 2027-01-06; 2027-01-07 would be refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: 2026-09-24 is day 16 of 120; the last day 2027-01-06 would still qualify (inclusive).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_id: 4e8d922d-2270-4370-8486-0a736e022ecd — Id; the single-use virtual card ending 2785 returned by find_card_accounts; basis: docstring 'the reference number of the debit card the purchase was made on'; unique: the disputed purchase is on that card only.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_txn_id: 6b96c213-df72-4025-bfa8-f176d09cc168 — Id; the 172.75 Maple & Rye Catering Windsor purchase (PWC 6630 9014) returned by find_card_transactions; basis: rule 'the card's settled purchase, its authorizations and its merchant credits all belong to that purchase'; unique: the card's only settled purchase — the three authorizations and two credits are not purchases.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.dispute_amount: 49.25 — calculated: settled 172.75 less the authorized reference 100.00 (three same-day incremental authorizations totalled), less the gratuity allowance 15.00 (dining, online: 15 percent of 100.00), less the exchange allowance 2.50 (foreign, settled 3 days after the latest authorization: 2.5 percent), less the merchant credits counted 6.00 (both unlinked, so every credit on the card) = 49.25.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the credit on filing on the single-use card; the rest of the overcharge stays in dispute.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_id: 4e8d922d-2270-4370-8486-0a736e022ecd — Id; the single-use card ending 2785; basis: docstring 'the reference number of the debit card the disputed purchase was made on'; unique: the dispute filed at step 8 is on this card.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_txn_id: 6b96c213-df72-4025-bfa8-f176d09cc168 — Id; the disputed purchase; basis: the filing receipt of step 8 carries card_txn_id 6b96c213-df72-4025-bfa8-f176d09cc168; unique: the only open incorrect-amount dispute on the card.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount: 47.75 — calculated on the world after step 8: overcharge on record 49.25; ceiling = RND(25.00 x 1.25, 2) 31.25 + deposit uplift 5.00 (3720.00 in three months) + plan uplift 3.00 (Prime) + standing uplift 2.00 (limitation lifted 24 months before) + merchant acknowledgement 5.00 (6.00 of credits) = 46.25; excess 3.00 is above 2.00 and within 5.00 -> 46.25 + 1.50 = 47.75.

factor_trace: authorized_reference_rule (method): three authorizations 80.00 + 12.00 + 8.00 all on 2026-09-05 (incremental) -> reference = 100.00; baseline (the authorization the purchase settled against, 80.00) gives 72.75.
gratuity_rate_tier (parameter, multi-source): the purchase is dining AND online -> 15 percent -> allowance RND(100.00 x 15 / 100, 2) = 15.00; baseline 0 percent gives 64.25.

exchange_tolerance_tier (parameter, multi-source): the purchase is foreign AND settled 2026-09-08, 3 days after the latest authorization 2026-09-05 (>= 3) -> 2.5 percent -> allowance 2.50; baseline 0 percent gives 51.75.
merchant_credit_rule (method): credits 4.00 (2026-09-15) and 2.00 (2026-09-18), none linked -> every credit counts, 6.00; baseline (linked credits only, 0.00) gives 55.25.

plumbing: settled_amount = 172.75 (the only purchase; the released incremental holds are authorizations, not purchases); result = RND(MN(172.75, MX(0, 172.75 - 100.00 - 15.00 - 2.50 - 6.00)), 2) = 49.25.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the card carries two or more authorizations AND all of them were placed on the same day (incremental authorizations)
the purchase is in the dining category AND was made online
the purchase is foreign AND settled slow_settlement_days or more calendar days after the card's latest authorization
the card carries merchant credits AND none of them is linked to the purchase

factor_trace: tenure_multiplier_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): personal account opened 2023-06-19, 39 whole months -> threshold x 1.25 = RND(25.00 x 1.25, 2) = 31.25; baseline (x 1) gives 40.00.

deposit_uplift_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): direct deposits 2026-07-01, 08-01, 09-01 at 1240.00 = 3720.00 in the three months (the 2026-06-01 deposit is outside) -> at least 300.00, below 4000.00 -> 5.00; baseline 0.00 gives 41.25.
plan_uplift_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): linked plan Pocketwire Prime -> 3.00; baseline 0.00 gives 43.25.
standing_uplift_tier (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): restriction_reason returned_funding, lifted 2024-09-04, 24 whole months before -> 2.00; baseline 0.00 gives 46.75.
merchant_ack_tier (parameter): merchant credits posted on the card 6.00 >= 5.00 -> 5.00; baseline 0.00 gives 41.25.

near_ceiling_release (method): overcharge on record 49.25 exceeds the ceiling 46.25 by 3.00 (> 2.00, <= 5.00) -> ceiling plus half the excess = 46.25 + 1.50 = 47.75; baseline (lower of overcharge and ceiling) gives 46.25.

plumbing: overcharge_on_record = 49.25 filed - 0.00 resolved on the single-use card (the 2025 incorrect-amount dispute is on the physical card); on_filing_ceiling = 31.25 + 5.00 + 3.00 + 2.00 + 5.00 = 46.25; result = 47.75.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: it has been open mid_tenure_months or more but fewer than long_tenure_months whole months
they total at least atm_reimbursement_dd_threshold but less than deposit_uplift_high_total
the linked plan is Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime
its most recent limitation was lifted standing_lookback_months or more whole months before the filing date
the merchant credits posted on the single-use card total at least merchant_ack_total
it exceeds the ceiling by more than whole_release_margin but no more than split_release_margin

edges.condition: The single-use card carries a card_dispute_filed record of reason incorrect_amount on its purchase, with its dispute_amount recorded, and no card_dispute_resolved record for that purchase.
edges.policy_source: The credit on filing is not booked until the single-use card's purchase stands on the records with an open incorrect-amount dispute.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At the opening the only dispute records are the physical card's 2025 incorrect-amount dispute and its denial; nothing references the single-use card's purchase, so the overcharge on record on that card is 0.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's filing at step 8 creates a card_dispute_filed record of reason incorrect_amount on the purchase with dispute_amount 49.25; overcharge_on_record becomes 49.25.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the credit on filing reads the overcharge recorded by the filing, so the filing comes first; there is no parallel prerequisite to reorder.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the filing leaves overcharge_on_record 0.00, so credit_amount recomputes to 0.0 instead of 47.75, and no filed dispute exists in the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona says only that the caterer charged far more than the order and that she wants the extra back; it never mentions a dispute to be filed first, allowances, credits or order. It agrees to file in her own name only after the agent explains it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_on_filing_dispute_credit_86bd6080 in task_tools.py reads no dispute and writes the credit whatever the records hold; file_incorrect_amount_card_dispute_a0bf950b checks no window, duplicate or status.
